correctness.rationale: For odd d no majority tie, H indicator=(1+sign sum x_i)/2. Separate even (degree0,2) vs odd (degree1) Walsh bands to obtain C=I/2+[0 B; B* 0]. Only degree-one alpha=2^-d C(d-1,(d-1)/2) and degree-three beta=-alpha/(d-2) sign Fourier coefficients matter. Pair-to-vertex incidence R with R*R=(d-2)I+11* yields exactly two singular sectors s=alpha sqrt((3d-1)/2), t=alpha(d-1)/sqrt(d-2), with multiplicities one and d-1; remaining half-eigenspace has C(d-1,2) dimensions. Direct incidence eigenfunctions attain both bounds; d=3 has three zero modes; strict inequalities and limit follow from exact binomial ratios. Independently generated full sample compression Gram matrices at d=3,5,7; predicted eigenvalues agree within 5.56e-16.
